documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Approval Of Un-Audited Standalone And Consolidated Financial Results For The Quarter/Half Year Ended 30 September 2026

analysis.summary: Chembond Chemicals Limited held its second analyst and investor meet for the second quarter and year ended March 31, 2026, reporting a consolidated revenue of Rs. 326.15 crores for the full financial year. Management highlighted strong volume growth in the water technologies business, which grew by 36% in the second half, alongside robust performance in construction chemicals and distribution segments despite early-year monsoon disruptions. Profitability faced near-term margin pressures from rising input costs related to metals, prompting proactive force majeure measures and price renegotiations. Chembond Chemicals published its May 2026 Concall presentation detailing financial and operational updates for the period ending March 2026.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the revenue outlook continues to remain positive across all business units.
guidance.quote: Revenue outlook continues to remain positive. However, on the earnings, profitability is a little bit of a challenge right now.

guidance.claim: Management noted that the sales growth outlook looks positive across all business units.
guidance.quote: All of these businesses are having strong sales pipelines and we see that the sales growth outlook looks positive across all these business units.

guidance.claim: Management expects H2 to grow at a steady rate in the water business unit.
guidance.quote: So we hope H2 would be we also be growing at a steady rate.

guidance.claim: Management hopes that the second half of construction chemicals will perform better.
guidance.quote: So this first half year that is quarter one and quarter two. The sales are mostly affected by a monsoon. Prolonged monsoon had affected our sales but the trend is now on the growing side. So we hope it's to would be much better than each one.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates that revenues in construction chemicals and distribution will improve in Q3 and Q4.
guidance.quote: So marginally, the revenue is down, but we hope this would improve in quarter three and quarter 4.

guidance.claim: Management expects EBITDA improvement in the current half year alongside an increase in revenue for the water business unit and construction chemicals units.
guidance.quote: our EBITDA improvement is expected now in this half year with an increase in revenue is what we foresee for Water Business Unit and especially Construction Chemicals Units.

guidance.claim: Management expects the water treatment market domain to grow at a pace of around 7 to 8% while expecting the company to grow at 10 to 15% year on year.
guidance.quote: So we see a steady growth of seven to 8% in the market, but we would probably grow at a rate of 10 to 15% year on year.

demand_outlook.claim: Management observed that construction is a potential site everywhere, including buildings, bridges, dams, airports, and roads.
demand_outlook.quote: Everywhere you see construction is a potential site. So every building, every bridge, every dams, every airport or a road would be a potential customer for construction chemicals.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the water business is entering the new financial year with a strong order book for chemicals and equipment.
demand_outlook.quote: Water BU, we are entering this, as I mentioned earlier, with a strong order book for chemicals as well as for the equipment.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the revenue outlook remains positive across all business units.
demand_outlook.quote: Revenue outlook remains positive across all business units

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the water business unit is backed by a strong order booking and a healthy ongoing enquiry pipeline.
demand_outlook.quote: This is on account of strong order booking what we have received in current Financial year also we have a healthy enquiry pipeline which is ongoing.

demand_outlook.claim: Management observed stability in the supply chain with equipment and system deliveries on schedule.
demand_outlook.quote: We are seeing stability in our supply chain and equipment and system deliveries are also on schedule.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the revenue outlook remains positive across all business units including construction, chemical distribution, and cleaning and hygiene.
demand_outlook.quote: and our outlook remains positive across all business units. That is construction, chemical distribution and cleaning and hygiene.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that sales in construction chemicals were affected by a prolonged monsoon, but activity has been on the growing side since September.
demand_outlook.quote: So this first half year that is quarter one and quarter two. The sales are mostly affected by a monsoon. Prolonged monsoon had affected our sales but the trend is now on the growing side.

margins_costs.claim: Management reported a 3% impact on margins in the immediate month due to haywire input costs.
margins_costs.quote: The total impact is, I mean, I don't know whether I can give you up to the day updates. But in the immediate month, we saw about a 3% impact on our margins due to these haywire costs.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that material costs started increasing from the end of February and March, with key materials tracking up due to metal volatility.
margins_costs.quote: Material costs started increasing from March, end of Feb, March. A lot of volatility in metals before that. So some key materials that we use are based on metals, so zinc and molybdenum and stuff like that. All of them had been tracking up.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted improved margins on lower RM costs and newer product technologies.
margins_costs.quote: Improved margins on lower RM costs and newer product technologies

margins_costs.claim: Management attributed the increase in consolidated EBITDA for the second quarter to good gross margins and improved cost optimization.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased on account of good, good gross margins what we had and improved cost optimization.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that consolidated PBT improved due to lower raw material cost and newly introduced product technologies.
margins_costs.quote: Our consolidated PBT for second quarter 25-26 was at Rs. 9.62 crores, again up by 6% as compared to last quarter. So improved margins were on account of lower raw material cost and new product technologies which we brought in

margins_costs.claim: Management reported that gross profit margins are stable.
margins_costs.quote: our material cost, our gross profit margins are stable.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that the company operates 3 manufacturing locations.
Management noted that the team size is 950.
Water Technologies reported a strong order book for specialty chemicals.
orders_capacity.quote: Strong order book for specialty chemicals

orders_capacity.claim: Management noted a robust enquiry pipeline in the Water BU.
Equipment and systems deliveries were reported to be on schedule.
orders_capacity.quote: Equipment and systems deliveries on schedule

orders_capacity.claim: Water Technologies had a 36% stronger order book.
Management stated that the water business unit has almost 100 plus crores of new order book apart from regular business.
orders_capacity.quote: As far as the order booking is concerned in the water business unit we have almost 100 plus cr. of new order book which is apart from the regular business.

orders_capacity.claim: Management quantified the water order book split as approximately 85 to 90 crores in chemicals and 10 to 12 crores in equipment.
orders_capacity.quote: almost Rs. 85 to Rs. 90 CR is in the chemical’s domain and Rs. 10 Cr. to Rs. 12 Cr. is in the equipment’s domain.

capital_allocation.claim: Management maintained a tight credit policy for construction chemicals with days sales outstanding around 88 days.
capital_allocation.quote: We are maintaining a tight credit policy and our day sales outstanding for construction chemicals is around 88 days as on 31st of March 2026.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management highlighted that post-war declaration was a very challenging period with limited surplus inventories requiring customer rationing.
risks_headwinds.quote: And post-war declaration, it was a very challenging period. We had limited inventories of surplus inventories but had to ration them across customers.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that public sector units refused to accept force majeure until the government declared it.
risks_headwinds.quote: About 30 percent of our total business in the water business comes from public sector units, and none of them had accepted a force majeure until the government just declared it two weeks ago.

risks_headwinds.claim: Material costs increased due to war impact, with some volatility in metal compounds.
risks_headwinds.quote: Material costs increase due to war impact, some volatility in metal compounds

risks_headwinds.claim: Construction Chemicals faced a prolonged monsoon before activity picked up post monsoon.
risks_headwinds.quote: Construction Chemicals BU – prolonged monsoon, activity has picked-up post monsoon

risks_headwinds.claim: Management pointed to a sluggish growth in the industrial end-market and delayed projects as reasons for slower revenue growth.
risks_headwinds.quote: Second is that there has been a sluggish growth in the end on the industrial front in which we operate some of the projects have been delayed quite a lot and we could not invoice those projects which are getting.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management highlighted that smaller players and startups continuously break market prices, causing margin pressure.
risks_headwinds.quote: there are so many small players now in the market. People who moved away from multinationals or even Indian bigger companies starting their own startups. They continuously keep on breaking the price in the market, so we need to keep on competing with them also. So the margins pressure is always there

management_commitments.claim: Management expects volume growth of around 15% to 20% in construction chemicals for quarter one.
management_commitments.quote: Coming to quarter one of this year, we foresee around 15 to 20% of volume growth in construction chemicals.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that volume growth in water chemicals would be roughly around 10%.
management_commitments.quote: Water chemicals, it would be roughly around 10%.

management_commitments.claim: Post demerger compliances are on track and records are being updated.
management_commitments.quote: Post demerger compliances are on track, records being updated

management_commitments.claim: Management stated an internal milestone of targeting 1000 crores in revenue in about four years.
management_commitments.quote: Internally, we're looking at about four years odd to hit 1000 crore milestone, how well it gets achieved. Of course, there are a lot of external factors, but we hope to be on course to get there.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
